blurb:
Unwind after dinner with a decadent sampling of some of Canada’s finest treats and sweets. Sip on a rich Canadian wine, savour locally crafted delights, and indulge in an array of irresistible desserts from Banff. It’s the perfect way to end your day... sweet, satisfying, and distinctly Canadian.

Our tours are proudly themed around the authentic Rocky Mountain Canadian experience — think fresh mountain air, hearty local bites, and laid-back exploration. We walk, we nibble, and we soak up the charm of Banff without any pretense. It’s not about fine dining; it’s about real flavours, real places, and real stories — all rooted in the spirit of the Rockies.

Visit some real hidden gems, as you snack on a variety of Canadian favourites.
